content: लयः [ली-अच्] .²1 Sticking, union, adherence. .²2 Lurking, hiding. .²3 Fusion, melting, solution. .²4 Disappearance, dissolution, extinction, destruction; universal destruction (प्रलय); लयं या ‘to be dissolved or destroyed’. .²5 Absorption of the mind, deep concentration, exclusive devotion (to any one object); पश्यन्ती शिवरूपिणं लयवशादात्मानमभ्यागता <ls>Māl. 5. 2</ls>, <ls n="Māl. 5.">7</ls>; ध्यानलयेन <ls>Gīt. 4</ls>. .²6 Time in music (of three kinds-- द्रुत, मध्य, and विलम्बित); किसलयैः सलयैरिव पाणिभिः <ls>R. 9. 35</ls>; पादन्यासो लयमनुगतः <ls>M. 2. 9</ls>; मध्यलम्बितपरिच्छिन्नस्त्रिधायं लयः <ls>Nāg. 1. 14</ls>. .²7 A pause in music. .²8 Rest, repose. .²9 A place of rest, abode, habitation; अलया <ls>Śi. 4. 57</ls> ‘having no fixed abode, wandering’. .²10 Slackness of mind, mental inactivity; (also used in adjectival sense; यदा जयेद्रजः सत्त्वं तमो मूढं लयं जडम् <ls>Bhāg. 11. 25. 15.</ls>). .²11 An embrace. .²12 The Supreme Being. .²13 The union of song, dance, and instrumental music; गायतं मधुरं गेयं तन्त्रीलयसमन्वितम् <ls>Rām. 7. 93. 15</ls>. .²14 A swoon. .²15 The quick (downward) movement of an arrow.
